desc: Ideation: per-color required set = nodes with 1 ≤ dist ≤ maxDist of that color's balls on X's cycle; answer = union size; unreachable ball → -1
Implement solve(): parse input, build inverse permutations, compute distP/distQ on X's cycles, validate balls, compute maxRed/maxBlue, count union, print answer
Verify against samples 1–4 mentally; check edge cases (no balls → 0, balls at X need nothing, X never operated)
